name: otfcc
baseline: ttx (fontTools, Python) for dumping fonts to text; Adobe makeotf for building a fully-optimized CFF OTF
workload: Converting OpenType fonts to and from a text/JSON form: otfccdump against ttx on CFF OTF and on TTF files, and otfccbuild against makeotf when building a fully-optimized CFF OTF; the README does not say which fonts, how many runs or how time was measured.
claimed_speedup: 4x faster than ttx on CFF OTF, and 40x on TTF; 900x faster than makeotf for building a fully-optimized CFF OTF (README key features, verbatim)
tradeoffs: Works by serializing a font to JSON and building it back from JSON, so it is a dump/build pipeline and a C library for parsing and writing OpenType files, not an in-place editing API or a text shaper. Archived and read-only, so no fixes will land. The README says it was developed and optimized for Clang/LLVM and prefers GCC 5.1 or later otherwise. Higher -O levels of otfccbuild (-O2, -O3) change the output font (merge features, subroutinize, force CID, ignore glyph order).
caveats: First-party README claim only: no hardware, font files, font sizes, tool versions, run counts, compiler or flags are given, and the repo tests directory (cffdump-opcode-check.js, ttf-roundtrip-test.js, payload) holds correctness checks, not a benchmark. ttx is a Python tool, so the 4x and 40x rows are C against Python, not C against another C/C++ implementation; makeotf is Adobe's AFDKO build tool and probably takes different input than otfccbuild, so the build job may not be identical (inference, not stated in the README). The README does not say which -O level the 900x build used. Undated numbers, and both baselines have changed since the repo was archived in 2022. A web search snippet (typedrawers.com forum posts, page could not be opened, getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) says early author posts gave 26 MB Chinese TTF parse about 10 s versus about 10 min for ttx and a 24 MB font built in about 6 s versus about 4 min for ttx; snippet only, not used for the tier. Bundled third-party code under dep/extern was not audited for licences.
